name: Programming Foundations
description: Learning to write, structure and test code; entry point for students with little or no programming experience.

name: Algorithms
description: Algorithmic thinking, data structures and complexity analysis; for students who want to solve computational problems efficiently.

name: Data Engineering
description: Storing, modeling and querying data with relational and NoSQL databases.

name: Data Science
description: Statistics, data analysis and drawing conclusions from datasets; foundation for AI and research-oriented work.

name: Machine Learning
description: Training and evaluating predictive models, from classic ML to neural networks; for students interested in AI.

name: Artificial Intelligence
description: AI applications including language models, NLP and responsible AI topics.

name: Web Development
description: Building web applications: frontend, backend, APIs and deployment.

name: Security
description: Understanding and defending against security threats; secure coding and penetration testing in lab settings.

name: Cloud & DevOps
description: Cloud platforms, containers, serverless and infrastructure automation; for students aiming at operations or platform engineering roles.

name: Project & Teamwork
description: Managing projects and working effectively in teams: agile methods, communication and leadership skills.

name: Hands-on Project
description: Modules assessed mainly through practical project work rather than written exams; good for students who learn by building.

name: Career Foundations
description: Broadly required base modules that unlock many follow-up modules and are expected in most study plans.

name: English Instruction
description: Modules taught in English; relevant for exchange students or students preferring English.
